subject: Having problems running shiny app (on shinyapps.io) within an iFrame in a drupal page

messages.author: 53edadbd89a3ca9c
messages.subject: Having problems running shiny app (on shinyapps.io) within an iFrame in a drupal page
parts:
I am running a shiny app (https://claney.shinyapps.io/dataAvailabilityApp/) within an iFrame on a Drupal page (http://neoninc.org/data-resources/get-data/data-product-availability). 

There are three pre-populated drop downs that filter the data that are used to dynamically generate a chart (ggplot). In all browsers and systems we have tried so far, the app works fine using the direct URL at shinyapps.io. And in Safari on a MacBook Pro, the chart loads automatically with the pre-populated values. 

However, other PC users using Chrome or Firefox, the chart does not load until a user 'nudges' the app by changing the selection in one of the drop down boxes. Is this a bug with shinyapps.io? 

Thanks!
Christine
